name: Article Loader (paste a table into the chatbot library)

parameters.content:
# 📚 Article Loader
Loads your help articles into the chatbot's library (Elasticsearch) from a pasted table.

## How to use
1. Click **Execute workflow**, then open the **Test URL** shown on the *Article Form* node.
2. Prepare a table (Excel or Google Sheets) with the columns **title**, **content**, **url**, **category**, **tags**. Only title and content are required.
3. Select all the cells, copy, and paste them into the form.
4. Choose **Yes** to replace old articles (this deletes the samples), then submit.
5. Change the address in the **Settings** node only if your Elasticsearch is somewhere else.

parameters.formDescription: Paste a table copied from Excel or Google Sheets. The first row must contain the column names: title, content, url, category, tags (only title and content are required).

nodes.name: Article Form
nodes.notes: The page where you paste your articles.

nodes.name: Settings
nodes.notes: Must match esUrl and esIndex in the chatbot's Config node.

nodes.name: Parse Articles
nodes.notes: Reads the pasted table (tab, comma or semicolon separated) and prepares the articles.

nodes.name: Parse OK?
nodes.notes: TRUE: articles found. FALSE: show a clear problem message.

nodes.name: Remove First?
nodes.notes: TRUE when you chose Yes in the form.

nodes.name: Delete Old Articles
nodes.notes: Deletes every article currently in the index.

nodes.name: Upload Articles
nodes.notes: Sends all articles to Elasticsearch in one request.

nodes.name: Check Result
nodes.notes: Checks that Elasticsearch accepted the articles.

nodes.name: Show Result
nodes.notes: The final page you see in the browser.
